name: Hako Kuroi
source:
Hako Kuroi is a genin from Konohagakure and a member of Team 25. Hako is a very straight-forward person with a melancholic demeanour. She is very free and open with her opinions and likewise can be very blunt. Along with this direct nature, she is extremely perceptive, able to notice the smallest of details from a quick observation. Hako has dark blue hair and purple eyes that are often obstructed by her bangs. Her outfit consists of a black dress with a cape, as well as gloves and a ribbon on her head. Hako is able to manipulate puppets.

[In game description]
